prompt: RFC 1035 resolver SLIST address no history round trip time
answer: For an address in the resolver’s SLIST with no history, RFC 1035 recommends assuming an expected round-trip time of **5–10 seconds as the worst case**, with **lower estimates for addresses on the same local network**. The history should be maintained **per resolver-address/server-address pair**.
